item.name: Crypto miners in Nkom's data-centre register
item.description: Troll Housing AS (97%), Thermaltech AS (100%), Exanorth AS (100%), Currency Edge AS (100%), Arctic Flux AS (95%), Bluebite GmbH (55%), Bluefjords AS (14%), Nordic Blocks AS (1%) – share of capacity used for crypto mining. Two figures with different units: (1) Nkom's list on 3 Oct 2026 – 8 of 60 commercial data-centre operators report crypto mining (in-house data centres are not published). (2) The minister's answer of 18 Sep 2026 (Doc. 15:3707) – 9 registered data centres doing crypto mining.
